scope: concept previews only, not runtime assets

variants.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: concept-only pixel-art protagonist outfit sheet, for an existing Godot game.
Inputs: 1 is the APPROVED C one-handed body atlas: sole authority for identity, anatomy, helmet, body proportions, subdued navy palette, broad color clusters and reduced selective contour. 2 is the existing two-handed body atlas: POSE/hand-position reference ONLY, do not inherit its changed coat shading or silhouette. 3 is an old seven-outfit portrait sheet: outfit design cues ONLY, do not copy its standing pose or drawing style.
OUTPUT: one wide 2:1 transparent PNG, exactly TWO full-body figures in two equal SQUARE cells, left one-handed IDLE, right two-handed IDLE. Ideally 1024x512, each cell512. NO TEXT, no weapons, no shadow, no floor, no halo, no background, no glow. Full figures must fit.
Both figures face RIGHT with the exact same side/three-quarter view and same planted feet as top-left IDLE cell of inputs1 and2. Keep helmet crown about y40/512 and boots baseline y486/512; preserve their locations inside each square cell. Do NOT use the aim, recoil, reload poses. ONE-HANDED left: near hand at (344,226), free far hand low at (374,306), matching input1 top-left. TWO-HANDED right: trigger hand (327,224), support hand (405,267), matching input2 top-left. Coordinates relative to each512cell; scale proportionally if larger. Hands must remain bare warm tan blocks, arms don't extend farther. No gun: real game guns will be layered later.
Both halves must visibly be the SAME PERSON with the SAME HEAD, helmet brim/lamp, short visible face, torso mass, leg length, knee and boot shape. Only the necessary forearms/hands differ for the existing grip. Match input1's TOP-LEFT figure especially: quiet blue-grey grouped shadows, large flat pixel clusters, restrained material-colored boundaries, only dark overlap accents, no continuous black silhouette stripe, no new sharp tiny highlights, no dense texture, no smooth shading, no optical blur. Avoid chibi, inflated helmets, thin elongated arms, tiny detailed buckles, glows.
OUTFIT: retain the APPROVED BASIC WORK OUTFIT from input1 exactly: muted navy blue split coat, rust-red shoulder scarf, small olive pack, dark trousers, brown boots, existing sparse straps. Left is a faithful reproduction of input1 top-left C. Right derives the SAME body/helmet/coat/legs and same blue-grey shadow shapes from this C figure, changing ONLY arms/hands to input2 top-left grip. Do not redesign or recolor the work outfit. This sheet tests style unity between grips.
variants.repair_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit INPUT1 (the TWO-figure transparent outfit sheet).
INPUT2 is the authoritative current TWO-HANDED IDLE weapon hold, shown in the equipment screen; INPUT3 is the approved C hero style.
CRITICAL FIX: change ONLY THE ARMS/HANDS OF THE RIGHT FIGURE into input2's LOW READY TWO-HANDED hold. Its rear/trigger hand is near the lower sternum; the forward/support hand is OUT TO THE RIGHT AND LOWER, at belt/navel height. The line joining the two hands SLOPES DOWN TO THE RIGHT, approximately 29 degrees. Both elbows bent naturally. Current right figure incorrectly raises arms above the trigger hand or lacks a hand. It must have exactly TWO visible hands and support a gun pointing diagonally DOWN RIGHT. Do not use firing/aiming/high ready poses. Do NOT add a gun: the real gun will be composited separately.
Keep the left figure's arm positions intact. Keep both figures' helmet, face, identity, head/body size, legs, boots, clothing colors, silhouette, and pixel cluster style unchanged. Keep each figure in its current cell, same scale/baseline. Keep sparse large grouped pixel colors and selective dark boundaries; do not add fine detail or heavy black border. True transparent background, no text, ground, glow or cast shadow. Return same two-cell-wide layout.
